properties.name: Marugame Udon
properties.popup_body:
Meet Marugame. Japan’s favourite Sanuki udon kitchen! Udon noodles made with skillful hands in our open kitchen, unhurried broths, flavour-filled, freshly fried tempura topped with condiments to compliment.
You’ll walk into our kitchen, grab a tray and head up to the counter to see your food made right in front of your eyes. Exceptional quality and unbelievable value for money.  
All served with love, that’s the Marugame way.

Pure Sports Medicine offers the only one-stop pit-stop for health, fitness and well-being outside of professional sports. Whatever your health and fitness goals, Pure Sports Medicine is the team behind you all the way.

PSM has built its solid and trusted reputation on the expertise of its international team of leading Doctors and Clinicians, many of whom continue to work with National, Olympic and World Championship Athletes.

properties.name: Ultimate Performance
properties.popup_body:
Work with Ultimate Performance in their second private personal training gym in Canary Wharf.

You’ll find ‘the world’s best personal training experience’ at Level 2, Cabot Place West, two years on from the launch of U.P. Wood Wharf.

Following the huge demand and incredible success of U.P. Wood Wharf, they’re giving even more people the opportunity to partner with some of the leading personal trainers on the planet.

Trainers who are incentivised to do just one thing; deliver the best possible results for you.

U.P.’s time-tested methods proven with 25,000+ clients, mean that if you commit to the process, you will achieve life-changing results no matter your age, ability, or starting point.

You might think you need to spend hours in the gym every week, but that’s not true. U.P.’s ‘maximum results, minimum time’ model means you need an average of just 2.7 hours of gym time every week to get results. It’s personal training like you’ve never seen before.

Start your own transformation today: https://ultimateperformance.com/

properties.popup_body:
n our glorious, maddening city, your workout can be the difference between good day and bad. Third Space are London’s luxury health clubs; individual in style, bound by a common philosophy: to provide outstanding fitness spaces that members feel are their own.

properties.name: Gallio
properties.popup_body:
Gallio in Cabot Place, a gem among Canary Wharf restaurants, is where the Mediterranean’s vibrant freshness and heart-warming flavours come alive. Nestled within the Atrium Kitchen’s embrace, Gallio is your go-to spot for dining, be it with friends, family, colleagues, or a quiet solo retreat.

Our soul rests in dough inspired by ancient grains, but our culinary repertoire stretches beyond. Our all-day menu, bursting with dishes crafted from fresh, top-notch ingredients, caters to every palate at all hours. Be it a stuffed pita that sings of the Med or a pizza that dances with its flavours, each bite is an experience.

Pair your meal with our spirited cocktails, an array of non-alcoholic concoctions, or our curated wine selection. Opt for a quick Grab-&-Go lunch, skip the queues, or take a seat, revelling in the buzz of our open kitchen and tables that accommodate all group sizes.

But Gallio is more than just a restaurant. It’s a stage for experiences. Indulge in our bottomless brunch, master the art of pizza-making, or gather your tribe for a feast with our specially designed set menus for larger groups. At Gallio, every visit is a journey adorned with Mediterranean delight.

properties.name: German Doner Kebab
properties.popup_body:
Coming soon to Cabot Place. Kebabs Done Right.

Our delicious game-changing kebabs are the best there are, bringing a high-quality taste sensation. Succulent, fresh, unique, and delicious – we are revolutionising the Doner kebab across the UK.

Our gourmet kebabs are freshly prepared by our passionate and friendly team in front of your eyes, using premium, lean, succulent meats and fresh local vegetables, served in handmade toasted breads with unique signature sauces.

Location: Cabot Place

properties.name: Zizzi
properties.popup_body: At Zizzi we’re all about delicious Italian food with a twist to surprise and delight all tastes, because good food does more than fill you up, it brings people together. Our menu is bursting with exciting Zizzi dishes, from Rustica Pizzas and mouth-watering Pasta, to adventurous salads and indulgent desserts. We do things a bit differently here… By doing it the Zizzi way, we always add a little twist to the classics to keep the Great Times rolling. Location: Cabot Place

properties.name: Nando's
properties.popup_body:
Relax, roll up your sleeves and get stuck in the Nando's way! The flame-grilled PERi-PERi chicken is legendary. Cooked to order in a choice of spicy bastes ranging from the mild Lemon & Herb to the tongue-scorching Extra Hot, there's a style to suit all tastes. A quick lunch, a family party, an evening with friends - whatever - Nando's menu, brimming with tasty appetisers, side dishes, salads and desserts, is the business. Bottomless soft drinks are fun for kids and the sharing platters are excellent value. Add beers and quality wines galore and the picture's complete. For a unique flavour in cool surroundings, visit Nando's!

Office Delivery / Collection Service

- Order to collect in store via www.takeaway.nandos.co.uk
- Order for delivery by emailing canarywharf.cabotplace@nandos.co.uk by 5pm the day before the order is required for delivery by 12pm at the latest or earlier if required. Minimum spend for delivery �50. Orders to be paid by cash or card in the restaurant on the day or earlier in the week. Deliveries up until 12pm and after 2.30pm 7 days a week.

Location: Cabot Place

properties.name: Boisdale of Canary Wharf
properties.popup_body:
Boisdale of Canary Wharf is a two-floor venue overlooking Cabot Square which comprises a restaurant, four private dining rooms, Oyster Bar & Grill with a terrace, whisky bar, Cuban Cigar Library & shop and live music venue.

The restaurant's music programme comes with the seal of approval of no less than Jools Holland, Boisdale's Patron of Music. The programme is packed with the best in jazz, blues and soul and highlights have included performances by the likes of Georgie Fame, Ruby Turner, Cuban legend Chucho Valdes, Chris Barber, Big Boy Bloater, Ruben Richards, Acker Bilk, Buddy Greco, Stephen Triffitt, The Congo Faith Healers, Mitch Winehouse, Mud Morganfield and many more.

The second floor restaurant is decorated in the instantly recognisable Boisdale signature look of lacquer red and dark green walls hung with eclectic and original artwork. It is here that one can find the whisky bar, a 12 metre long 'amber wall of liquid gold' that holds over 1,000 bottles of malt whisky. One floor below is the art deco-inspired Oyster Bar & Grill which benefits from an awning-covered heated terrace complete with members-only area. Four private dining rooms are available, accommodating from 12 to 40 guests.

Location: Cabot Place
properties.street_address: Cabot Place, Canary Wharf, London, E14 4QT

Every day, more than 11 million guests visit Burger King® restaurants around the world. And they do so because our restaurants are known for serving high-quality, great-tasting, and affordable food. Founded in 1954, Burger King is the second largest fast food hamburger chain in the world.

The original Home of the Whopper, our commitment to premium ingredients, signature recipes, and family-friendly dining experiences is what has defined our brand for more than 50 successful years.

properties.name: Atrium Kitchen
properties.popup_body:
Bringing together several establishments serving cuisine from around the world, Atrium Kitchen in Cabot Place is the answer when you can’t quite decide what you’re in the mood for. 
    
You’ll find a feast of options at these Canary Wharf restaurants.Gallio serves delicious Mediterranean options, while German Doner Kebab offers a selection of gourmet doner kebabs served in handmade toasted breads. Marugame Udon is all about hand-made udon noodle dishes, while Nando’s offers legendary peri-peri chicken that fuses Portuguese and African flavours, then Zizzi  brings authentic Italian dishes with a few exciting twists. Atrium Kitchen’s restaurants are perfect for groups of all sizes. 
    
See individual restaurants for their opening times
